repo_notes.content: This is a microfrontend (MFE) platform framework. Documentation is a single-page site composed of HTML fragments. Core concepts: fe(*) bare specifiers, raw source JIT compilation, and import-map orchestration.
repo_notes.author: fe-platform maintainer

overview.purpose: Single-page docs site. It use a fragment-based architecture where sections (Architecture, Product Eng, Platform Eng, Tutorials) are toggled via CSS. The build system uses Bun to compose these fragments into a final index.html.

pages.title: Architecture and conventions
pages.purpose: Details the moving parts (@fe/cli, compiler, runtime, etc), the fe() convention, ES module exports, and the JIT deployment model.

pages.title: For product engineers
pages.purpose: A guide for MFE developers on independent feature lifecycles, devtools-based overrides, and toolkit usage.

pages.title: For platform engineers
pages.purpose: Walkthroughs for setting up a platform: from POC to Cloud deployment and Enterprise toolkit patterns.

pages.title: Proof of Concept
pages.purpose: Quickstart for platform engineers to set up two MFEs and a shell locally.

pages.title: Cloud Deployment
pages.purpose: Details on CDN caching, CSP configuration, and horizontal scaling of the JIT server.

pages.title: Enterprise and Ecosystem
pages.purpose: Patterns for building reusable toolkit packages and managing CLI/JIT plugins.

pages.title: Tutorials
pages.purpose: Hands-on tutorials: Hello World, Multi-team composition, Shared state, and Custom JIT plugins.
